# {bin}

This project's development environment is declared in `{bin}.yml` and managed by `{bin}`. Your shell usually does not have the project environment activated, so ports, service URLs and project-local tools are missing unless you go through `{bin}`.

## Learn the project

Run these before guessing anything about services, ports, env vars or project commands:

- `{bin} status --json`: dependencies and whether they are installed, services with their ports, the environment variables `{bin}.yml` sets, and the project commands.
- `{bin} services --json`: each service's backend, whether it is running, its host and port.

Both print one JSON document to stdout and change nothing. Secret-looking environment values show as `<redacted>`.

## Run tools in the project environment

Run project tools, tests and scripts with `{bin} exec -- <program> [args…]`, for example `{bin} exec -- npm test` or `{bin} exec -- cargo test`. The program gets the project's environment variables, `<SERVICE>_HOST`/`<SERVICE>_PORT` for each service, and the project's PATH entries, so the right tool versions run.

- The program runs directly, without a shell. For pipes, redirects or `&&`, wrap the command: `{bin} exec -- sh -c 'npm test | tail -50'`.
- The exit code is the program's own.
- Use the `<SERVICE>_PORT` variables instead of hard-coding ports. Ports are assigned per project and are often not the default.

When `{bin}.yml` defines a project command for the task (listed under `commands` in `{bin} status --json`), run it as `{bin} <command>` instead.

## When something is wrong

- A service is stopped: start it with `{bin} start <name>`.
- A service fails or misbehaves: read its logs with `{bin} logs <name>`.
- To see everything that doesn't match `{bin}.yml`: run `{bin} check --json`. It exits 1 when it finds issues and lists them under `issues`.
- Dependencies are missing or the environment is out of date: ask the user to run `{bin} up`, which installs packages and starts services.

## Don't

- Don't edit `{bin}.lock` or anything under `.shadowenv.d/` by hand. `{bin} up` generates them. Change `{bin}.yml` instead, then run `{bin} up`.
- Don't install project dependencies with a system package manager. Add them to `{bin}.yml`.
